name: review
description: Evidence-backed code review, Pending PR review drafts, claim verification and author responses.

interface.longDescription: Review code with evidence, save or resume unsubmitted Pending drafts while preserving manual edits, verify existing claims, and handle author-side review responses. PR review preserves source and pins draft comments to the reviewed commit.
interface.defaultPrompt: Review the current changes and report evidence-backed findings.
